concepts.label: Tort litigation
concepts.definition: Work involving an asserted civil tort claim.
concepts.inclusion: Premises negligence action
concepts.exclusion: A standalone coverage opinion

concepts.label: Premises liability
concepts.definition: Work involving a claimed duty tied to the condition, use, or security of a premises.
concepts.inclusion: Negligent-security suit against a hotel
concepts.exclusion: A hotel wage dispute

concepts.label: Insurance law
concepts.definition: Work addressing insurance rights, obligations, or relationships.
concepts.inclusion: Interpretation of an insurer's obligations under a policy
concepts.exclusion: A liability defense file whose only insurance fact is payment

concepts.label: Insurance coverage
concepts.definition: Work examining whether and how a policy responds to a claim or loss.
concepts.inclusion: Opinion on a water exclusion
concepts.exclusion: Defending a hotel on the merits of a negligence claim

concepts.label: Property insurance coverage
concepts.definition: Coverage work on an insurance policy covering property or related losses.
concepts.inclusion: First-party warehouse flood coverage advice
concepts.exclusion: Coverage for a third-party bodily-injury suit

concepts.label: Labor and employment
concepts.definition: Work addressing employment, labor relations, or employment-law obligations.
concepts.inclusion: Defense of a wage-and-hour claim
concepts.exclusion: Personal injury suit involving an employee unrelated to employment rights

concepts.label: Privacy law
concepts.definition: Work addressing duties about personal information and privacy rights.
concepts.inclusion: Advice on a customer privacy notice
concepts.exclusion: Software license interpretation without privacy issues

concepts.label: Appellate practice
concepts.definition: Legal work on the review of decisions in an appellate forum.
concepts.inclusion: Appeal brief on a civil-rights decision
concepts.exclusion: Pretrial motions in the original proceeding

concepts.label: Transportation liability
concepts.definition: Work involving legal liability from transportation operations.
concepts.inclusion: Defense of a motor carrier in a collision claim
concepts.exclusion: Property advice for a company that happens to own trucks

concepts.label: Products liability
concepts.definition: Work involving allegations of harm from a product subject to product liability claims.
concepts.inclusion: Design defect action over an unsafe battery
concepts.exclusion: Warranty advice with no liability dispute

concepts.label: Professional liability
concepts.definition: Work involving responsibility for the standard of professional services.
concepts.inclusion: Defense of an accountant accused of audit malpractice
concepts.exclusion: Payment dispute without any alleged professional duty

concepts.label: Construction
concepts.definition: Work addressing building, design or construction relationships and obligations.
concepts.inclusion: Building envelope defect dispute
concepts.exclusion: Slip-and-fall unrelated to construction work

concepts.label: Healthcare
concepts.definition: Work about healthcare provision, institutions or healthcare law.
concepts.inclusion: Hospital privacy or facility regulatory advice
concepts.exclusion: Routine lease advice for a commercial landlord without healthcare issues

concepts.label: Government and public entity
concepts.definition: Work addressing public entity authority, obligations or liability.
concepts.inclusion: City defense in a public employment or civil rights claim
concepts.exclusion: Private contract matter involving no public entity or public power

concepts.label: Commercial disputes
concepts.definition: Work involving disputes over commercial rights or obligations.
concepts.inclusion: Shareholder dispute over director duties
concepts.exclusion: Corporate due diligence before a proposed sale

concepts.label: Cybersecurity
concepts.definition: Work addressing security of systems or digital information.
concepts.inclusion: Advising on response to a ransomware incident
concepts.exclusion: Review of a privacy notice without a security issue

concepts.label: Negligence
concepts.definition: An asserted negligence claim or topic requiring legal review. Assertion status is separate.
concepts.inclusion: A pleading alleges negligent conduct
concepts.exclusion: An incident report without a legal allegation

concepts.label: Medical malpractice
concepts.definition: A theory alleging breach of a healthcare professional standard of care.
concepts.inclusion: Negligent surgery allegation
concepts.exclusion: Inadequate facility security unrelated to professional care

concepts.label: Duty to defend
concepts.definition: An issue about an insurer's contractual defense obligation.
concepts.inclusion: Declaratory action over duty to defend
concepts.exclusion: A carrier invoice without an issue about its obligation

concepts.label: Deposition
concepts.definition: A deposition event involving recorded sworn testimony outside trial.
concepts.inclusion: Witness deposition in discovery
concepts.exclusion: Written transcript as a document

concepts.label: Deposition transcript
concepts.definition: A written transcript of deposition testimony.
concepts.inclusion: Official written deposition transcript
concepts.exclusion: Counsel's summary of a deposition

concepts.label: Acquisition due diligence
concepts.definition: An event in which information is investigated for a proposed acquisition.
concepts.inclusion: Review of an acquisition target's material contracts
concepts.exclusion: Vendor compliance review outside an acquisition
